name: z-lab DFlash v1 block head on standard Qwen3 targets (external draft route)
source_revision: the commit that adds this record (parent 41a8f39d6fa77abd817919ad9acd826010edec21)

draft_checkpoint.use: weights loaded strictly into mlx2's existing dflash_base.DFlashDraftModel math; modeling_dflash.py and dflash.py read as data, never imported or copied, to confirm the forward (hidden_norm(fc(taps)) context, q from the block, k/v from context plus block with k_norm, RoPE with queries on the last q_len positions, is_causal=False with no mask, target embed_tokens and lm_head, draft KV cropped to the context) and that the reference computes its taps with build_target_layer_ids instead of reading the configured list
draft_checkpoint.tokenizer_files: none in the drafter repository: it shares the target's embedding and LM head. Pairing checks vocab 151936, BOS 151643, EOS 151645; mask 151669 is past every target tokenizer id (last 151668), an embedding row tokenization never produces

rejected_checkpoint.reason: declares Qwen3DSparkModel with markov_rank 0 and no confidence head (a DFlash block under a DSpark label) with its own embedding and LM head; no license and no model card, so no reference semantics and no recordable licence. adapters/dspark.py refuses it; it is not used

mined_local.mechanism: plain DFlash external route contract: committed-context append, per-layer row batching, per-position exact laws with processor probes, best-first and pattern trees, serializable empty KV planes
mined_local.modifications: moved unchanged into runtime/drafters/plain_dflash.py as PlainDFlashDraftModel with class-level receipt_kind / receipt_name / label; KimiDFlashDraftModel is now a subclass that sets the Kimi names, and its receipt identity was checked byte-identical before and after the move

mined_local.mechanism: strict header-only inspection, target pairing, content-stable fingerprint, re-verification before load
mined_local.modifications: Qwen3 parser: exact dflash_config keys, reference-computed taps, no last-layer tap, BF16 only; mask id accepted as a reserved special token or an untokenizable embedding row

license: Original mlx2 code (MIT, no Apple header); drafter weights MIT; target weights Apache-2.0

validation.selected: explicit only: an --external-draft policy naming the artifact on a standard Qwen3 target; no default changed
validation.observed_used: not yet: CPU tests only (tests/test_dflash_v1_cpu.py: strict config refusals, tokenizer pairing, numpy transcription of the reference forward matched within 2e-4 for tied and untied heads and for incremental context, artifact round trip and tamper refusal, route draft_distributions equal to the reference argmax after committed context and on batched rows, greedy external route equal to ordinary decode on a tiny target, Kimi receipt pinned); the real z-lab weights inspect and strict-load on CPU. No GPU load of Qwen3-4B with the drafter has run
validation.untested: the tap mapping (mlx2 post-layer taps == HF hidden_states[id+1]) is verified by reading code, not by a test against transformers; the StandardDecoderAdapter dflash_v1 branch has no CPU test and is first exercised by the GPU baseline (P0); z-lab configs other than Qwen3-4B-DFlash-b16 are unchecked and may fail closed
